title: Microsoft Edge: apply pending updates when the browser is idle
summary: The roadmap facts and the three existing relaunch policies are supported. However, the page overstates the absence of idle-restart controls: Microsoft documents a separate idle-restart action in the Edge management monitoring dashboard. The Group Policy controls also lack support for their claimed tenant scope.

claims.claim: Microsoft Learn documents no setting specific to idle update restarts.
claims.quote: Force auto restart when device is idle: This action automatically restarts the users' browsers to apply the latest update when their device is detected as idle.
claims.fix: Replace the broad absence sentence with 'The RelaunchNotification reference does not yet document the idle-restart extension described in this roadmap item.' Narrow controls[3].governs to 'The idle-restart extension to RelaunchNotification described in this roadmap item' and retain its null sides. Do not equate that gap with absence of all idle-restart controls: the monitoring dashboard documents a separate Force auto restart when device is idle action, not the roadmap's policy extension.
